after.zh: 两个方向的坡度合成一个长度，边缘强度就和边的方向无关了：横边、竖边、斜边一样亮。方向本身是 atan2(gy, gx)，箭头总指向变亮最快的方向，在边上和边垂直。切到「坡度」画法看输入：箭头就画在每个像素上。
after.en: Combining the slopes in two directions into one length makes edge strength independent of edge direction: horizontal, vertical and diagonal edges are equally bright. The direction itself is atan2(gy, gx); the arrow always points where the brightness rises fastest, and on an edge it is perpendicular to the edge. Draw the input in the "Slope" view: the arrows are drawn at every pixel.

t.zh: 明暗从哪来已经讲完，这一关转向边：明暗变化很快的地方。要找它，先得说清每一点「变得有多快」。
t.en: So much for where light and shade come from. This level turns to edges: places where brightness changes fast. To find them, first say how fast the brightness changes at each point.

t.zh: 坡度有两个分量：往右走亮度变多少（gx），往下走变多少（gy），两个合起来是一个箭头，叫梯度。Sobel x 在每个像素量 gx，Sobel y 量 gy。
t.en: A slope has two components: how much the brightness changes going right (gx), and going down (gy). Together they make an arrow called the gradient. Sobel x measures gx at every pixel, and Sobel y measures gy.

caption.zh: Sobel x 处理圆盘：左右两侧反应强，上下几乎没有
caption.en: Sobel x on a disc: strong on the left and right, almost nothing at the top and bottom

t.zh: 难处在方向。物体的边有横有竖有斜，只量一个方向的坡度会漏掉另一些边。一个好的边缘强度，不该因为边转了个方向就变弱。
t.en: The difficulty is direction. Object edges run horizontally, vertically and diagonally; measuring the slope in one direction only misses some of them. A good edge strength should not get weaker just because an edge turns.

t.zh: 新画法「坡度」：画出等高线，再在各处画一个箭头，指向变亮最快的方向。
t.en: A new way of drawing, "Slope": contour lines, with an arrow at each place pointing where the picture brightens fastest.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：在每个像素输出梯度箭头有多长。测试里有方块、圆盘、字母 X 和一个角，边朝着各个方向。
t.en: Your task in this level: at every pixel, output how long the gradient arrow is. The tests have a square, a disc, a letter X and a corner, with edges facing every way.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：方块 → 期望

brief.zh: 坡度有两个分量：Sobel x 量往右走亮度变多少（gx），Sobel y 量往下走（gy）。两个合成一个箭头，在每个像素输出箭头有多长：√(gx² + gy²)。不管边是横的、竖的还是斜的，越陡的地方越亮。
brief.en: A slope has two components: Sobel x measures how much the brightness changes going right (gx), and Sobel y going down (gy). Together they make an arrow; at every pixel, output how long that arrow is: √(gx² + gy²). Whether an edge is horizontal, vertical or diagonal, the steeper it is, the brighter.

hint.zh: 箭头的长度怎么从两个分量算出来？想想勾股定理。
hint.en: How do you get the arrow's length from its two components? Think of Pythagoras.
